description: API bridge configuration for external platform integrations and AI copilot support

workflow.assistant_role: Jarvis coordinates scoped recall and specialist swarm handoffs through Tower Control

platform_routes.hostinger: Private hosting on a suitable VPS; provisioning and deployment approval required
platform_routes.github: Approved repository context and pull request handoffs; no private memory in commits or dispatch payloads
platform_routes.chatgpt: Reviewed context export or a separately verified supported connector
platform_routes.chatgpt_business: Workspace-admin-approved context only; separate from personal ChatGPT memory
platform_routes.gemini_ai: Verified MCP-capable client such as Gemini CLI, otherwise reviewed context export
platform_routes.claude: Verified MCP-capable client, otherwise reviewed context export
platform_routes.claude_coworker: User-selected Claude coworker/Cowork environment; verify client support and permissions first
platform_routes.perplexity: Reviewed research export with citations; connector availability must be verified
platform_routes.youtube: Rights-cleared transcripts in; human-approved publishing handoff out
platform_routes.substack: Authorized exports in; reviewed drafts handed off manually unless a supported integration is verified
platform_routes.facebook: Authorized content in; approved publishing through a separately configured Meta integration
platform_routes.instagram: Authorized content in; approved publishing through a separately configured Meta integration
platform_routes.linkedin: Authorized content in; reviewed publishing with account and API permissions verified
platform_routes.slack: Explicitly selected channels and approved summaries; app scopes and workspace consent required
platform_routes.zapier: Allowlisted workflow references only; authenticated adapter required before webhook use
platform_routes.zoom: Consented transcripts and approved action-item summaries; recording access and retention review required

memory_policy.notes: Required adapter controls, not native enforcement guarantees. Use separate stores or an authorization-enforcing service; palace wings and rooms are organizational labels, not security boundaries.

mempalace.notes: Declarative routing only: this repository does not install MemPalace, run a Jarvis service, provision Hostinger, or implement platform adapters. Local core memory does not require a provider API key. Remote access and cloud disclosure require a separately reviewed authenticated service.

github.notes: Used for cross-repo dispatch, reading repository data, and triggering workflows

github_copilot.notes: GitHub Copilot is used as an AI copilot layer for Hermes toolkits, clone engine fabric work, and swarm system development

replit.notes: Replit used as live development environment

notes: Store all secrets in GitHub Repository Secrets or a vault — NEVER commit raw keys.
